summary: Decrements the reference count of a COM-like container. When the count reaches zero, invokes the destructor callback off_5D43C8 on the contained inner object, frees the secondary resource via FreeWrapper_7bcf, and clears both stored pointers. Sets the vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_5ACF08 on entry.

operations.description: Set vtable pointer at this+0x0 to off_5ACF08.
Destructor callback off_5D43C8 is non-null before any release work.
Inner object pointer at this+0x4 is non-null.
Decrement reference count stored at this+0x8.
Release when the reference count was exactly 1 before the decrement, or the decremented value is negative.
Invoke destructor callback off_5D43C8 on the inner object at this+0x4.
Secondary resource pointer at this+0xC is non-null.
Free the secondary resource at this+0xC via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Clear secondary resource pointer this+0xC to 0.
Clear inner object pointer this+0x4 to 0.
Return the last function-pointer / result value.

unresolved: Exact target of the indirect destructor callback off_5D43C8 is not resolved; the packet lists callee candidates 0x004D4780 / 0x004D4790 that are only reachable through it.
Global off_5D43C4 is read in the surrounding object but not referenced in this function body.
Element type and ownership semantics of the inner object and the secondary resource depend on the container's constructor, not visible here.
